decline.amy: Twelve reading plans and a 5K in the morning. Take your mother. She has more energy than all of us.
decline.boppy: Not today. My stomach is doing something. Take Deedee. She already has her shoes on.

decline.amy: Science fair tomorrow and three of my kids are presenting. Take Dad fishing. He's been asking since you landed.
decline.deedee: Not this time, honey. I have three pies in and Boppy needs somebody to go fishing with. Take the girls.
Not tonight, honey. I made a plate for the teachers. Somebody has to keep Boppy away from it.
decline.boppy: A school? At night? My stomach says no. My knees say absolutely not.

decline.amy: Progress reports. Every one of them takes an hour, and every one deserves it. Take the girls. They both have library cards. I made sure.
decline.deedee: Not today, honey. Book club at four. We're reading the same book as last month. Nobody finished it.
decline.boppy: A library? I read a book once. 1974. It was about fish. It wasn't accurate.

decline.amy: Report cards AND a 10K on Saturday. Go. Take Mom and Dad. Make Dad wear the tie.
decline.deedee: Not yet, honey. I'm still deciding on earrings. Come back with the invitation.
decline.boppy: Not yet. I'm still looking for the tie. I have one tie.

decline.deedee: Not this time, honey. Somebody has to start Sunday dinner. Every clock in my kitchen says midnight and the roast doesn't care.
decline.boppy: An airport? At midnight? I'm still recovering from the tie.
